$comment: Roborock robot vacuums: the key from the Roborock account once, then LAN only (pattern P4). Found by their UDP broadcasts. Format: wiki Device-Templates.
name: Roborock vacuum
description: Roborock robot vacuums set up with the Roborock app (S5 Max, S6, S7, S8, Q5, ...); Mi Home ones with their token.

inputs.label: Roborock account email
inputs.hint: The email you log in to the Roborock app with

inputs.label: Show the map
inputs.hint: The map only comes from Roborock's cloud: it needs internet, and the hub keeps a Roborock session for it (never your password). Everything else works without.

inputs.label: Which app was the vacuum set up with?
Vacuum address
inputs.hint: Its IP address, from your router or the app's network info, e.g. 192.168.1.134

inputs.label: Local key
inputs.hint: 16 characters, from a Roborock token tool

inputs.label: Token
inputs.hint: 32 hex digits, from a Mi Home token extractor

setup.label: Log in to the Roborock account

steps.hint: Roborock emails you a code. The hub uses the account once, to fetch the vacuum's key; after that it controls the vacuum on your network only, also without internet. Your password is never asked.

errors.unreachable: The hub can't reach the vacuum. Is it on, and on the same WiFi as the hub?
